missing_value: empty string for not applicable; UNSPECIFIED for unconfirmed track
track: official event track, supplied via --track or config/submission.json
rank: positive integer; rank only within its own module
candidate_sequence: four strands in 1c,2c,3c,4c order separated by semicolons; also provided as separate columns
prediction_value: numeric; unit and direction given in adjacent columns
numeric_precision: original exported precision, up to 12 significant digits for AI proxy
ai_metric: dimensionless six-edge local count sum; higher proxy score ranked first, then candidate_id
screening_metric: best Vina energy in kcal/mol; original complete-eight-box rank by hit-box fraction descending, energy ascending, mean energy ascending, ID
paired_site_substitutions: one paired change corresponds to two actual nucleotide substitutions
structure_file: relative PDB path when available; empty for sequence-only AI export
evidence_type: model_prediction or docking_prediction; no synthetic software-test candidate permitted
cross_module_score_comparison: not defined; units and meanings differ
transport: reported as independent model tables/summary, not attributed to individual Opt candidates
